### Notes

- PARAMCD 'PHQTOT' is DERIVED in ADQSPHQ from SDTM QSPH QSTESTCD='PHQ0111' (QSTEST 'PHQ01-Total Score'). Do NOT use the 10 item-level PHQ0101..PHQ0110 records.
- LOCF-DEPENDENT: only 2 subjects have an OBSERVED Week 24 PHQ-9 total; 13 have a baseline and 6 have an EARLY DISCONTINUATION RETRIEVAL record. Mandatory rule 2 (DTYPE='LOCF', ANL01FL='Y' at the endpoint visit) will supply most analysis records. Expected analysis n ~13.
- The generator MUST report n(observed) alongside n(analyzed) on the table face — critic finding R-2.
- SITEGR1 in the model may be non-estimable after pooling (6 sites, 17 subjects). If the term is rank-deficient, refit without SITEGR1 and record the fallback in the ARD and the table footnote.
- LOCF imputation assumed from estimand EST1 'Treatment Policy' strategy — no SAP provided.
- N-GATE CAVEAT: this study has 17 randomized subjects (Placebo 5 / Low 5 / High 7). All inferential statistics are illustrative and must not be interpreted.
- **Denominator note.** The Efficacy population is N=13, but this analysis has n=10. The difference is not a dropped record: the population flag spans all three delivered efficacy instruments (PHQ-9, SWLS, AVLT-REY), whereas this table requires a non-missing baseline AND a Week-24 analysis value for THIS parameter specifically. The per-arm 'n' rows above are the analysis denominators; the column headers show the population size.
- Model: `CHG ~ TRTP + BASE`. LS-means via `emmeans::emmeans` with equal reference-grid weighting (the SAS LSMEANS default); contrasts via `emmeans::contrast` with explicit coefficient lists so each difference reads dose - comparator.
- **SITEGR1 was dropped from the model**: MANDATORY RULE 3 pooled all 6 sites into group 900 on randomized counts, leaving a single-level (rank-deficient) factor. Refitted as shown above.
- The 'n observed / n LOCF-imputed' row is shown on the table face because 2 of 10 analysis values are carried forward.
- All values computed from ADaM via the persisted ARD (`ard.csv`); no value is hand-entered.
- Rounding: SAS convention (half away from zero), applied at display time only.

> **N-GATE WARNING.** This study randomized 17 subjects (Placebo 5 / Zanomaline Low 5 / Zanomaline High 7). Every inferential statistic in this display is **illustrative only** and must not be interpreted as evidence of effect or of absence of effect.
